title: One-Sided Randomized Polynomial Time Is in Bounded-Error Polynomial Time
statement: Every language decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members is decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine that outputs the correct membership answer with probability at least $2/3$ on every input.
